lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: Hello, Commander.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: I have a suggestion I'd like to make.
What is it?

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: Signal has been binge-watching so many TV shows that she hasn't been getting much sleep.

lines.speaker: signal
lines.text: HHey1, wait!

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: I was hoping you could talk some sense into her, Commander.
Sounds like you're quite worried about her.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: I'm more concerned about the negative impact it may have on her job performance.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: If she continues staying up into all hours of the night, her performance is sure to suffer.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: This could lead to workplace accidents that would pose a danger to both you and me.

lines.speaker: signal
lines.text: Delta, wait! Listen to me!

lines.speaker: signal
lines.text: Commander, it's not like that.

lines.speaker: signal
lines.text: Uh... um...
Go on then.

lines.speaker: signal
lines.text: Yes, I've been watching TV shows.

lines.speaker: signal
lines.text: However, even when Delta has nothing else going on, I always end up watching TV by myself.

lines.speaker: signal
lines.text: So I decided to watch a military documentary.
Quite the change of pace.

lines.speaker: signal
lines.text: I thought it was really interesting, so I recommended it to Delta.

lines.speaker: signal
lines.text: Although to be honest, I would have kept watching it even if it was dry as dirt. I mainly wanted to see it so I would have more to talk about with Delta.

lines.speaker: signal
lines.text: Ugh, this is so embarrassing...

lines.speaker: signal
lines.text: I wanted to watch it on my own so that I could show off what I'd learned. I wanted to play it off like I was some kind of military expert.

lines.speaker: signal
lines.text: As it turns out, I was in front of the TV so often that I just made Delta worried about me.

lines.speaker: signal
lines.text: So, I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: Ah...

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: Why didn't you just invite me to watch it with you from the beginning?

lines.speaker: signal
lines.text: You'd watch it with me?

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: Of course. I'm sure I could glean something useful from the documentary as well.
So, what about the suggestion you mentioned a minute ago?

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: I'm sorry, Commander, I wasn't fully aware of the situation.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: I take back what I said.
Great!

lines.speaker: signal
lines.text: If you like, Delta, we can watch some of the documentaries in my room later!

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: Sure thing.
